sentences.sentZh: 一天，方方问爸爸：“我走，月亮也走。月亮为什么跟人走？”

sentences.sentEn: One day, Fangfang asked Dad, “When I walk, the moon walks too. Why does the moon follow people?”

sentences.sentEn: Dad said, “The moon is very high and very far away, so people can see it wherever they are. That's why you feel the moon follows you.”
